differences: Text A chooses one creature you control and one creature you don't control as targets once, and the same creature you control gets the +1/+0 and indestructible and then fights. Text B makes the fight a separate target choice of "target creature you control", so the fighting creature may be a different creature from the one pumped and made indestructible.

In Text A the snow condition gates only the pump and indestructible; the fight targets are chosen on cast regardless. In Text B the fight targets are chosen after the conditional pump, so the choice of fighting creature is not tied to the pumped one.
